If you sold shares in a given year, capital gains tax is likely due on any increase in the value of the shares that occurred between when your shares vested and when such shares were sold. The adjusted cost basis is the value used to assess if there was a capital gain when you sold your shares. Ensuring the adjusted cost basis is what is provided to your tax preparer or software is important to avoid paying double taxes.
